title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator (Kent Based)

Location: Kent - Flexible working arrangementsJob Type: Temporary - 6 Months plusSalary: £14.40 an hourStart Date: Immediate start available

We are currently recruiting for a reliable and organised Accounts Administrator to join a busy and supportive team on a temporary basis. Applicants must be based in Kent for occasional meetings or training if required.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous accounts or finance administration experience who is looking for flexibility and the chance to work within a professional environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing invoices and purchase orders
- Managing accounts payable and receivable
- Reconciling statements and resolving discrepancies
- Data entry and maintaining accurate financial records
- Assisting with payroll administration where required
- Handling email and telephone queries professionally
- Supporting the finance team with general administrative duties

Skills & Experience Required
- Previous experience within accounts administration or finance support
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and accounting systems
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- Ability to work independently and manage workload remotely
- A stable internet connection and suitable home working environment

What's on Offer
- Flexible and supportive working environment
- Immediate start available
- Opportunity to gain further experience within a professional finance team

If you are an experienced Accounts Administrator based in Kent and available for a temporary assignment, we would love to hear from you.

title: Procurement Administrator
description:
Procurement Administrator (3 Month Contract)

Looking for Your Next Procurement Opportunity?

Are you a highly organised administrator with a keen eye for detail and experience supporting procurement or purchasing functions? Reed Business Support are seeking a Procurement Administrator to join a busy and collaborative team on a 3-month temporary contract, providing essential support to ensure the smooth running of procurement operations.

This is an excellent opportunity to gain valuable experience within a fast-paced environment and make an immediate impact.

Day-to-Day of the role:
- Raising and processing purchase orders accurately and efficiently.
- Maintaining supplier records and procurement databases.
- Monitoring and tracking orders to ensure timely delivery.
- Liaising with suppliers and internal stakeholders regarding orders and queries.
- Managing procurement documentation and contract records.
- Supporting invoice reconciliation and resolving discrepancies.
- Producing reports and assisting with procurement-related administration.
- Ensuring compliance with company procurement policies and procedures.

Ready to take the next step in your career and enjoy:
- Valuable experience within a professional procurement function.
- Supportive and collaborative team environment.
- Opportunity to develop procurement and supply chain knowledge.
- Gain exposure to supplier management and purchasing processes.

We're looking for someone who is:
- Previous experience in administration, purchasing, procurement, or supply chain support
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
- Able to prioritise workload and work independently
- Experience with ERP or procurement systems would be advantageous

Apply Today!

If you're looking for a rewarding temporary opportunity within procurement, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact us for more information

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Project CoordinatorSevenoaks £30,000- £35,000 per annum Office Based Monday to Friday 9am-5:30pm 24 days annual leave, Pension, Company social events We are delighted to be assisting this small but growing Security business to find the latest addition to their team. Once projects are won, they would be passed to you and 2 colleagues to manage the project to completion- from ordering materials, to organising work, replying to queries, quoting and invoicing. This is a highly varied role where you will have to work independently whilst liaising with several different departments and client contacts. This is a varied, hands-on role that combines administration, customer service, scheduling, and project support responsibilities.

Administration & Operations
- Manage day-to-day office administration across service and project activities.
- Maintain accurate job records, reports, and operational documentation.
- Support processes relating to quotations, orders, invoicing, and job management systems.
- Assist with compliance administration, including quality, health & safety, and industry standards.

Project & Resource Coordination
- Schedule engineers for installations, maintenance visits, and reactive call-outs
- Occasional attendance for site visits (mostly London and expensed)
- Monitor job progress and ensure completion records are maintained.
- Coordinate project delivery activities, including:
- Resource planning
- Equipment ordering and logistics
- Site documentation
- Travel and accommodation arrangements
- Project timelines and cost tracking
- Invoicing and project close-out support

Customer & Commercial Support
- Process quotations, orders, and invoices.
- Provide customers with updates on orders, services, and project progress.
- Ensure all queries are resolved or escalated promptly and professionally.

About You

You are highly organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy working collaboratively while taking ownership of tasks and seeing them through to completion.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Proven experience in a senior administrative, coordination, or project support role.
- Strong customer service and communication abilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook.
- Experience coordinating field-based teams, engineers, or operational resources.
- Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

Desirable Experience
- Experience with job management, ERP, or scheduling systems.
- Knowledge of security, engineering, technical services, or construction environments.
- Experience supporting quality, compliance, or health & safety processes.
- Understanding of project coordination and resource planning.
